name: io.github.henfrydls/actual-budget-mcp
title: Actual Budget
description: Actual Budget, carefully: deletes preview first, and new transactions check for duplicates.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your Actual Budget server, for example http://localhost:5006

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for your Actual Budget server. Not needed if you set ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token for servers behind OIDC, which have no password. Use instead of ACTUAL_PASSWORD; if both are set, the token wins

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your budget's Sync ID, found under Settings > Show advanced settings

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Only needed if your budget file is end-to-end encrypted

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Every budget this server serves, comma separated, when it is more than one. Each tool then takes a budget_id, and each budget is opened in a process of its own

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORDS
environmentVariables.description: A JSON object of budget sync id to encryption password, for when more than one of the budgets is encrypted. Each worker is given its own and never the map

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_BUDGET_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: How many budgets stay open at once. Defaults to 3. A fourth budget closes the one that went longest without a call

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_WORKER_IDLE_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: How long an open budget with nothing to do stays open. Defaults to 15

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_WORKER_READY_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a call waits for a budget that is still opening before it answers that it is still opening. Defaults to 45

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide every write tool from the model, exposing only reads and analysis

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: Set to chat to offer the 18 everyday tools instead of all 44, which is 17.4 KiB of tool descriptions instead of 39.7 KiB on every connection. Defaults to full

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local budget cache

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for your server to start replying, in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000; raise it if a GoCardless bank sync is being cut off

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve MCP over HTTP on this port instead of stdio. Only for a server you run yourself and point clients at: a client that starts this package itself speaks stdio and cannot reach it once this is set

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The credential for the read path, /mcp. Required once ACTUAL_HTTP_PORT is set, and at least 32 characters

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_WRITE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A second credential, for the write path, /mcp-write. Without it the server serves no write path at all

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: What to bind to. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; inside a container that is unreachable, so 0.0.0.0 together with ACTUAL_HTTP_ALLOW_REMOTE

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_ALLOW_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to bind somewhere other than loopback. Nothing here terminates TLS, so put something in front of it that does

environmentVariables.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Hostnames to accept in the Host header, comma separated and without ports, for a server that is not on loopback. Anything else is answered 403
